current_answer: Start with the frontend task and project context. For one screen or small fix, use a bounded brief and inspect the render before installing a skill. When a skill fits, check its author and full instructions, not just its name: different frontend-design packages may share an install path. Record source revision, agent, scope, and prerequisites. No listed skill has a pool-run same-project outcome comparison.
